items.title_en: Essentials: Nicotine's Effects on the Brain & Body & How to Quit Smoking or Vaping
items.title_cn: Essentials: Nicotine's Effects on the Brain & Body & How to Quit Smoking or Vaping
items.desc_en: In this Huberman Lab Essentials episode, I explain how nicotine affects the brain and body, including how it increases dopamine, acetylcholine and norepinephrine to boost motivation, focus and alertness, suppresses appetite and raises heart rate and blood pressure. I distinguish nicotine itself from its delivery methods — smoking, vaping, dipping and snuffing — and explain their serious health risks, why vaping is especially habit-forming and why quitting is so difficult. items.title_en: Mushrooms for the Mind & Immune System | Paul Stamets
items.title_cn: Mushrooms for the Mind & Immune System | Paul Stamets
items.desc_en:
Paul Stamets is widely regarded as the father of modern applied mycology for his work on fungi and their applications in human health. We discuss how mushrooms and other fungi affect, and can improve, our immune system; how certain non-psychedelic mushrooms can enhance cognition and brain plasticity; and the use of psilocybin for depression, anxiety, and other mental health conditions, as well as important safety considerations. This episode is for anyone seeking to learn more about the biology of fungi and their medicinal and other uses.

Show notes: https://www.hubermanlab.com/episode/mushro
